verdict.rationale: Secureframe's docs say it automates the SOC 2 process "at every step" to get audit-ready, condensing 200+ controls into 8 steps. It also offers auditor-written policy templates and automated evidence collection with continuous monitoring through 100+ integrations, which covers the core of running a SOC 2 program in-platform. Missing for 10: explicit Type I vs Type II support, explicit mapping to the Trust Services Criteria, documented auditor evidence-request workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
